# Bid the closet, the bowl, and the extras.

> Price a toilet replacement from toilet count, two-piece versus comfort-height versus one-piece versus bidet-combo, swap-only versus flange-repair, owner-supplied versus plumber-supplied, weekday versus Saturday emergency, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $249 installed special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
